changes: Open, save and print from File at the right end of the toolbar. The Image menu next to Styles contains the crop, resize and canvas tools.
Use the selected object's three-dot menu to raise or lower its layer, or move it to the front or back.
Use the up and down arrows in Customize toolbar to change tool order.
Select defaults to Region for moving and deleting pixels. Switch to Objects to edit annotations, or draw directly over existing artwork.
Selected drawings have a lighter Styles shortcut and compact icon menus for arrangement and object actions.
Fill has a compact palette, an image eyedropper, and a three-pixel Grow or Shrink edge adjustment.
Medium is the default interface size and sits between Normal and Large.
Open Satin highlights the selected tool with a faint background tint and a stronger shade of its icon color.
The welcome guide uses sculpted tiles and keeps its tips, autosave note and shortcuts.
The App menu marks the active interface size with a high-contrast fill and underline in every finish.
Correct a photographed page with four corner handles and an optional Clean paper preview.
Adjust a selected area with shadow, highlight and feather controls that stay editable in the project.
Save smaller image or PDF copies with optional Crisp text sharpening and an actual-size preview.
Capture selection keeps preparing in the background even when the editor is hidden and native redraws are delayed.
Existing Recents thumbnails stay visible after capture. Only the new capture loads, avoiding the one-by-one strip redraw.
Paste text on an open canvas to create an editable text box. Double-click to edit, or drag to move it.
Paste images as movable, resizable canvas layers. Clipboard images take priority over accompanying URL text.
Pasted text keeps line breaks and the remembered Text style, supports undo, and stays editable in saved projects. Text fields retain normal paste behavior.
Completed fills keep their color when you choose a new color or transparency. Select an existing fill to recolor it.
SkyImage is now Bediz on Mac and Windows. Existing MyImage and SkyImage projects, settings and update identity carry forward.
Window scrolling captures independently scrolling panes in their original columns. Scroll each pane down in turn, then choose Done to combine them.
Combined captures preserve fixed headers and footers, with plain space below shorter panes and a pane count in the preview.
Fix scrolling capture after selecting a window, preserving the window target and handling fixed toolbars and sidebars.
Compact capture toolbar with icons, tooltips and a clear output percentage.
Keep Region or Window as your selection mode. After selecting, choose Capture for a still image or the scroll icon to collect a longer image, then Done.
Pause, restart or cancel scrolling capture. Escape cancels selection even when a capture menu is open.
Scrolling capture ignores localized cursor changes so repeated sections are not duplicated.
Output size still defaults to 100%; choose 75%, 50% or 25% for a smaller finished image.
Click the shortcut in Capture Now to customize your capture hotkey.
Quick Start & Hotkeys has a visible close button as well as Escape.
macos: Dismiss capture with Esc and return to the editor without resizing its window. Open completed captures as soon as their project is saved.
Show capture guides immediately over full-screen apps while keeping the current app active.
Show the capture overlay on the current desktop when a shortcut is pressed from another app or full-screen Space.
Use Helvetica for clearer menu, toolbar and dialog text.
Open images directly from Seyir with Edit in Bediz.
Restore the opaque editor title bar while retaining transparent capture overlays and smooth startup.
Retain the smooth, undimmed capture startup and full menu-bar/Dock selection.
Scrolling controls stay outside the captured image while the editor remains hidden.
windows: The compact capture controls and automatic region scrolling are shared with Mac.
Store-installed copies continue to check Microsoft Store for updates.
